notes: Regression: npm test 94 passed, typecheck and build ok, 39 of 40 verifier checks pass (F1 fails), app.mjs 64/64 on the rebuilt app.
The release workflow was not rerun after round 2; the Mac smoke test (run 43532765073) covers round 1's code.
A quiet failure is cached for six hours, hiding the team notice until the next check (allowed: stays quiet).
Round 1 note 2 (asking again after Later) is fixed by AC9's once per version.
Round 1 notes 1, 3, 4 and untested risk stand (README.md).
Release run 43532765073 ran at 4907efe; e1999fc changes only the Mac job's name (mac_app) and timeout (15 min). At 4907efe verification/10's sec7 check failed; at e1999fc all 38 checks pass.

The run had no Developer ID secrets and no version: Developer ID signing, notarization within 15 minutes, version stamping on the Mac and attaching to a draft release were not exercised. Stamping was run on Linux (Team-Board-0.2.0-x64.zip). The dmg itself is not signed by electron-builder's default; the app inside is.
The window loads http://localhost:<port>; the server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. A board link written with 127.0.0.1 opens in the browser.
After Later, a later 6-hourly check may ask again; a timer check overlapping a menu check can leave the menu check unanswered. No clause covers either.
Dark screenshots set the page's colour scheme directly (nativeTheme does not reach the page under xvfb); the app leaves themeSource at system.
Not tested (§9): a real signed update, a person opening the dmg. No Terminal window on a Mac follows from the .app bundle; the smoke test ran the binary directly.
